verdict.rationale: kitty documents dedicated font configuration (Changing kitty fonts, kitty.conf font options for family/bold/italic/fallback fonts and font_features tuning) and community reports strongly corroborate best-in-class ligature support (e.g., FiraCode ligatures cited as reason to switch from iTerm/Alacritty). Missing for 10: no first-party doc excerpt detailing per-font fallback selection algorithm or advanced font_features syntax beyond title listing, and no independent benchmark of fallback font correctness.
